name: linear
summary: Linear's hosted MCP server (issues, projects, comments) with browser sign-in
notes: Sign in with your Linear account in the browser: lotr setup linear. The server registers clients itself (dynamic client registration); nothing to create first.

scopes is left empty: the server decides. Linear says /mcp is read-write by default; requesting only the 'read' OAuth scope limits a token to read-only, and https://mcp.linear.app/mcp/readonly exposes only read tools.
Alternative: send a Linear API key or OAuth token as a bearer header (Linear suggests this for app users or restricted keys); that would be the mcp-http-key archetype.
The legacy SSE URL https://mcp.linear.app/sse is documented as a deprecated fallback; not used here.
Okta-managed (enterprise) authorization exists and needs a Linear admin to configure SAML; not needed for a personal sign-in.
The mcp-oauth kind takes no connect.policy; the gateway classes risky tool names (delete, send) as consent by itself.
Linear's docs name no tools, so no smoke op is set; setup will pick a read that needs no input.
